extraction: Only large per-episode/per-class arrays, file-hash maps, and raw audit arrays omitted; metric values unchanged.

report.protocol: Build connected components of EPISODES sharing any support/query photograph. Draw G photograph groups G times with replacement. Reaggregate sampled intersection/union within each class, compute each represented class IoU, then macro-average represented classes. Preserve group multiplicity in I/U. Identical group draws used for all arms in each exact cohort.
report.missing_class_rule: Class with zero sampled episodes has undefined I/U and is omitted from that resample macro; never assigned IoU0 or copied original score.
report.singleton_caution: With one episode per class, repeats cancel within class ratio; this intentionally differs from prior paired-class bootstrap. Latest user-specified estimand replaces, does not erase, earlier class-bootstrap results.
report.limitation: Uploaded exposed development cohorts; descriptive conditional bootstrap, no confirmation or population guarantee. CachedCRF and GT-privileged diagnostics retain separate scope.
